propositions: Agent guidance requires empirical p50, p90, p99 percentiles for plan-review and completion-verifier operations measured from end-to-end user-visible command wall time, not inner workflow metrics alone.

Direct instrumentation of gated-close operations across 620+ rollout logs and tracker sidecars yields reproducible matched cohorts with defined inclusion/exclusion rules, deduplication, and provider-clean filtering (bedrock: ran_model, numeric llm_calls > 0).

Plan-review current-regime duration is approximately 15–20 minutes (p50 × 1.20 through p90 × 1.20); completion-verifier gated-close is approximately 9–11 minutes, based on directly instrumented n=5 sample and confirmed mechanism decomposition.
Shared ticket-store write-lock contention during the analysis was proven to be intended behavior (controlled quiet-window barrier), not a rebar defect; no code or processes were modified.

All acceptance criteria met: statistics with sample size and provenance recorded; percentile method explicit (Hyndman-Fan type 7); no repository or guidance files modified; operator confirmation obtained before documented guidance update.
